description: List recent Collect pays, friend sends, and invoice pays started by the bound spend key, newest first. Filter by status: pending (waiting on Approve), paid (settled), or all. For paid Collect rows, call use_paid_offering with publicId. Related: pay_offering, pay_invoice, send_to_user, use_paid_offering.

inputSchema.description: Optional filters for pays started by this spend key.

limit.description: Maximum number of pays to return, from 1 to 40. Defaults to 20.

status.description: Which pays to return. pending = waiting on Approve, paid = settled, all = both. Defaults to all.

inputSchema.title: ListRecentPaysInput

name: list_recent_pays

outputSchema.description: Pays this VAPT started, newest first.

pays.description: Collect pays created by this spend key.

amount.description: USD amount as a decimal string.

isTrial.description: true when this row was a free trial grant.

outputSchema.title: RecentPays

title: List recent pays
